newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's John Deere issues new shares.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's John Deere issues new shares.

text.p: Mexico's John Deere S.A. de C.V., a tractor and agricultural equipment maker, has offered 10.53 million B series shares in order to boost its capital by 176.95 million pesos, the company said on Thursday.

Current stockholders will receive one new share worth 16.80 pesos for each 5.126878 existing B shares. The offer, approved by shareholders on November 12, began on November 15 and will run for 15 days from that date.
The new issue will give John Deere a total of 27.54 million A shares and 36.99 million B shares.
